sections.name: learning_rate
sections.title: Which learning rate works best?
sections.description: Peak learning rates 1e-5, 2e-5 and 4e-5 with linear warm-up and decay, and a constant 2e-5. A linear schedule averages about half its peak, so the 4e-5 schedule is the closest match in average learning rate to the constant 2e-5.

sections.name: speaker_embedding
sections.title: Does the starting speaker embedding matter?
sections.description: Speakers 7 and 24 were ranked closest and furthest to LJ by ECAPA on the pretrained voices; 7 is low-pitched and 24 high-pitched. Speaker 2 is male and speaker 0 is the default. The embedding-only run trains nothing but the speaker vector (constant learning rate, the same 2e-5 as the rest of the model in that run), so comparing it with the constant-rate full run (no_scheduler) shows how much the rest of the model contributes. Its training logs are shown with a repeat run and two runs whose speaker-embedding learning rate was 10x and 50x (the 50x run's folder is named 20xLR, but its training_config.json records 50); those two have no checkpoint to score.
